description: For a specific product (e.g. Canva), list each capability it provides and the best alternatives — ranking tools the user ALREADY owns first at $0 extra. Pass the capabilities the user actually uses (from get_tool) for a precise answer. Includes the honest case for keeping the tool.

capabilities.description: Capability slugs the user actually uses this tool for (default: its core capabilities)

owned_tools.description: Tools the user already pays for, by name or slug, e.g. ["ChatGPT Plus", "google-workspace"]

team_size.description: People who need access (affects per-seat costs)

tool.description: The tool the user is considering dropping

name: find_alternatives
title: Find cheaper ways to do what a tool does
